ContractIds.description: Deployed contract ids of a network. An empty string means "not deployed".

attestation_registry.description: `C...` contract id of the attestation registry, or "" when not deployed.

attester_registry.description: `C...` contract id of the attester registry, or "" when not deployed.

contracts.description: Deployed contract ids for this network.

rpc_url.description: Soroban JSON-RPC endpoint (http:// or https://). Used when `rpc_urls` is empty.

rpc_urls.description:
Ordered RPC endpoints for failover (primary first). Falls back to
`rpc_url` when empty (ADR-0011).
